usage.outputShape: body.result.chunks[].content (extracted text/markdown per chunk); body.result.chunks[].blocks[] for typed blocks with bbox+confidence; body.usage.num_pages / body.usage.credits for billing; body.job_id and body.studio_link for reference
quirks: Body field is document_url (a public URL to the PDF/image/spreadsheet) — there is no documented inputSchema, this field name was confirmed by a successful paid call.

Despite returning a job_id, the parse result is delivered INLINE and synchronously in the same response (body.result.chunks[]). Do NOT poll the job_id — there is no separate status/result endpoint needed.
response_type is 'parse'. To extract structured fields against a schema use the /extract sibling route instead of /parse.
Billed per page: body.usage.credits = pages processed (1 credit = 1 page).
usage.guide: POST to the Sponge purchase URL with a JSON body {"document_url":"<public URL to a PDF/image/spreadsheet>"}; payment is handled via x402 on Base ($0.05/call, billed per page). The response comes back synchronously as JSON — read the parsed content from body.result.chunks[].content (Markdown/text per chunk) and per-block details (with bounding boxes and confidence) from body.result.chunks[].blocks[]. Ignore body.job_id for retrieval; the result is already inline so no polling is required. Check body.usage.num_pages / body.usage.credits to understand billing.
